title: AI, Digital Platforms, and the New Systemic Risk
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate any aspect of faith or religion. It mentions 'religion' once as an example of a protected characteristic that can be the basis for systematic discrimination by AI and digital platforms.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Religion is only mentioned in passing as an example of a protected characteristic in the context of large-scale discrimination.
